response.sql: WITH nationality_totals AS (SELECT c.nationality, COALESCE(SUM(cr.points), 0) AS total_points, COUNT(cr.constructorResultsId) AS result_count FROM constructors AS c LEFT JOIN constructorResults AS cr ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId GROUP BY c.nationality) SELECT nationality, total_points, result_count, result_count - AVG(result_count) OVER () AS difference_from_average FROM nationality_totals ORDER BY nationality;

assumptions.assumption: All nationalities in constructors are included, even if they have no constructor result records.
